summary: Tested Parts Catalogue rename (sidebar, in-app, public, old-route redirects), the public part pop-up, Add from library, component pictures (upload, display everywhere, remove, validation, public serving) and the Edit component regression. All features work. Found and fixed one UI bug: the qty input in the Add-from-library dialog stretched to full width and squeezed the part description to nothing. INCIDENT: during cleanup my test script accidentally deleted customer item #30 (LV525306 MCCB) in 'DB-1 & 2 Component Costing'. A 'Delete' role selector matched the item-row delete icon, and my auto-accept dialog handler confirmed it. I restored it straight away with the original id, item_no 30 and seed values. Project totals now match the pre-incident state exactly (30 items, qty 32, SP $37,239.51, hrs 99.5, CC $28,782.01).

minor.issue: put_object/get_object use the synchronous 'requests' library inside async routes, which blocks the event loop for up to 120s per upload/download. Wrap them in asyncio.to_thread / run_in_threadpool.
The image type is checked only against the client-supplied Content-Type, with no magic-byte check. A non-image sent as image/png is accepted.

library groups by part_no.strip().upper(), but image/apply-all matching uses an exact part_no. Lines whose part_no differs only by case or whitespace show as one library part, but the picture/edit is applied to only some of them.
The files record is not marked is_deleted when the last item using an image is deleted, which leaves orphan files.

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED by testing agent: the qty input had 'editable-cell w-16', but .editable-cell @applies w-full, which overrode w-16. The input filled the row and the description/brand/part/rate text was squeezed to zero width (invisible). Changed to 'editable-cell !w-16 shrink-0 text-right'. Verified: width is 64px and the text is visible.

issues: Uses native window.confirm instead of a shadcn AlertDialog, which doesn't match the app's styling

Run storage requests calls off the event loop (asyncio.to_thread)
Optional: magic-byte validation for uploads; case-insensitive part_no matching in _matching_ids/apply_all to match library grouping; replace window.confirm with AlertDialog
Optional: ask the customer to confirm item #30 in DB-1 & 2 (LV525306 MCCB, rate 1318.59, 4+3 hrs, qty 1). It was restored from seed values, which matched the pre-incident totals exactly
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 864 lines; split it into routers (auth, projects, items, library/public, images, exports)
Sync requests.put/get in async endpoints (upload_item_image, serve_image) block the event loop
serve_image fetches from object storage on every request with no server-side cache; Cache-Control public max-age=86400 helps the browser only
AddFromLibrary reloads the full /library after every Add. That's acceptable at the current data size
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_LibAPI and TEST_Lib projects with TEST_ parts and 2 test PNGs; all deleted/removed (0 TEST items, 0 active files, 0 orphan items). Customer item 1a315f56-9ff8-4733-ac47-8e047481f56a was accidentally deleted and then re-inserted with the same id and seed values.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Real customer DB. Do NOT use get_by_role('button', name='Delete'): item-row delete icons have title='Delete' and will match. Do not auto-accept every dialog after a project delete. btn-del-project uses window.confirm. Use the TEST-PIC part pattern (a unique TEST_ part_no in a TEST_ project) for picture tests so customer parts are never touched.
